column1: # Columns: word, gold_ipa, category, validated, note
# gold_ipa uses the inventory in src/g2p/phoneset.py, space separated.
# VALIDATION STATUS. Every gold form below is drawn from standard descriptions
# of Hindi phonology and is marked validated=no. None of them has been checked
# against a native speaker or a pronunciation dictionary yet. The front-end
# accuracy number reported in the paper must come from the validated subset
# only, so this file is not usable as evidence until that pass is done. Flip
# the column to yes item by item, not in bulk.
# CIRCULARITY WARNING. The rule implementation and these gold forms were
# written by the same author in the same sitting, so the provisional accuracy
# figure (--include-unvalidated) is close to meaningless: it mostly measures
# whether the author was self-consistent. It currently reads 100%, which is
# evidence of circularity rather than of a good front end. The number becomes
# real only once an independent speaker has fixed the gold forms without
#   applies    the V C _ C V rule fires and the deletion is correct
#   blocked    the rule's context matches but speakers retain the schwa;
#              these are the rule's known failure mode and the reason a
#              lexicon exists. Populate from elicitation, not from memory.
#   mono       monosyllable; the only vowel must survive
#   cluster    explicit virama cluster interacts with deletion
#   nasal      anusvara or chandrabindu interacts with the surrounding vowels
#   loan       Perso-Arabic or English borrowing, often with nukta letters
